data.name: Blade & Sword 2: Ancient Legend
data.detailed_description:
This is a ported version of the original game, but not a remake version.

◆Game Introduction of Blade & Sword 2: Ancient Legend

Blade & Sword 2: Ancient Legend is an action-adventure RPG game that unfolds around an ancient Chinese mythology. 40 years after the defeat of the Emperor Jo, Chiyou's spirit, which had been suppressed for 3000 years was once causing trouble again.

◆Game Features

1.Full-screen dynamic lighting settings, with day-night system and various natural phenomena such as wind, snow, rain, and lightning realistically depicted, allowing players to experience a vivid world.

2.Extensive skill system is the highlight of the game, with rich battle skills and spectacular effects. The tight combat rhythm allows players to experience the tension and excitement as much as possible.

3.Players can move naturally with world coordinates system. Players can not only upgrade and develop their heroes but also enhance weapons to create their own powerful equipment.

4.Balanced character attributes with good performance in both speed and strength. Diverse attack moves including skillful ones, powerful fatal strikes, and long-range attacks, allowing players to experience various combat modes.

5.Over 20 battle scenes, each meticulously crafted and rich in content, presenting a visually stunning experience. The game seamlessly combines art and real world, adding exaggeration and innovation to our vivid design, immersing players in a captivating game world.

About the story

The story of Blade & Sword 2: Ancient Legend takes place forty years after the end of the previous story.

Time passed, those heroic deeds became a legend in people's heart, and the peaceful days had made them forget the pain in the past. Wa-dang Village had become a bustling crossroads, with merchants and tourists passing through from north and south... However, the peace did not last long. One day, Wa-dang suddenly plunged into crisis again. The disaster reminded people of the pain and fear they had forgotten for decades. They were calling out the hero's name, hoping for salvation. Will the hero stand out again this time?

With monsters ravaging outside, none of the passersby could escape from their miserable fate and many people died. Among them, the protagonist, severely injured outside the village, was saved by a local. Together with Shen, who had become a legendary hero, they embarked on a journey to exterminate monsters and demons.

How to Play

1. Protagonists with different abilities

In addition to the three main characters from the previous work, two brand-new characters were added: Swordsman, Great Warrior of Blade, Double Blade Swordswoman, Elder, and a hidden character. Each of them excels in their own skills and techniques, providing players with a more diverse combat experience.

・Swordsman

　Balanced attributes with good performance in speed and strength, featuring a variety of attack skills.

　Diverse attack moves including skillful ones, powerful fatal strikes, and long-range attacks.

　Overall, there were no significant advantages or disadvantages, making Swordsman a relatively easy-to-use character, suitable for beginners.

・Great Warrior of Blade

　High ATK, able to defeat enemies within a few moves;

　high HP and stamina, able to increase permanently certain attributes through self-training and practice.

　The drawback is slow speed, vulnerable to enemy attacks and challenging to execute high combo attacks.

　Great Warrior of Blade's moves requires practices, suitable for advanced players.

・Double Blade Swordswoman

　Fast and dexterous enough to make it difficult for enemies to aim while being able to attack them accurately.

　Able to make combo attacks and possesses a magnificent leg move. Seeks to destroy enemy's limbs by knives to disable their attacks without making fatal strikes.

　Also the only character who can use tactical support skills.

　The downside is weak attack power, short attack range, and low HP. Suitable for intermediate players.

・Elder

　Being different from previous character, specializes in long-range attacks and reducing enemy abilities.

　The drawback is slow attack speed, low HP, and defense values, requiring proficient attack timing while maintaining distance from enemies.

　Suitable for experienced players that familiar with game maps and enemy features.

・Hidden Character

　A mysterious figure that requires players to clear the whole game to unlock under certain conditions. Please give it a try.

2. How to operate

Mouse left button: move/interact/release the skill set by the left button

Right Mouse button: Release the skill set by the right button

Shift：Run

Alt：Defense

Spacebar: Dodge

Hold down the Alt key and use the left mouse button to draw trajectory of the Killing Blow: switch between Killing Blows

Z key: Pick up with one click

Keys 1～6: Use the corresponding potion

F1～F6：Use the corresponding inventory
